intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published M.Tech / M.E. colleges in India. This list of the best M.Tech / M.E. colleges under ₹{{budget}} lakh includes IIT and NIT cards whose stored fees look incomplete.

IIT Kharagpur is listed first with M.Tech Aerospace Engineering at ₹10,000, which is our lowest quotable fee and is unlikely to be the full official programme cost. NIT Warangal follows, with M.Tech Power Electronics and Drives at ₹82,000.
Most colleges here are private, but the first cards include public institutes. Confirm the official fee notice, especially for GATE-funded seats, which often have a different official structure.
listLead: These are the top M.Tech / M.E. colleges in India 2026 with a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹1 lakh. Each card is tied to a branch, such as aerospace, power electronics or mechanical, so compare the same specialisation.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} published colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private, {{public}} are public, and two have no ownership type. Eight records have a fee band that can exceed ₹1 lakh.
A stored IIT or NIT fee close to ₹10,000–₹25,000 is often a semester tuition, a hostel component, or an old annual figure. Use the official fee circular for the current admission year.
firstCollegesLead: IIT Patna appears under the short name "Indian Institute of Technology (IIT)" in our records, with M.Tech Mechanical Engineering at ₹21,500. Government Engineering College, Thrissur, is listed at ₹19,190, and RIT Kottayam at ₹13,250.

SSN College of Engineering, Chennai, is listed with M.Tech Communication Systems at ₹25,000. None of these first-card placement averages are filled in our table, so do not infer a package from a blank cell.

sections.heading: Why an IIT M.Tech fee can look too low
paragraphs: IIT and NIT fee circulars usually split tuition, hostel, mess and one-time charges. Our card may have stored only one of those lines.
If you hold a GATE stipend, the official out-of-pocket cost can differ from the listed tuition. Always read the current institute notice.

compare.heading: How to compare the best M.Tech / M.E. colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: A public IIT or NIT branch and a private M.E. programme can share this cap in our records and still differ sharply in official fees and GATE cut-offs.
bullets: The official fee circular for the exact branch, including hostel and one-time charges.
Whether the recorded figure is a semester, a year, or the full programme.
GATE or state-entrance eligibility for the seat you want.
The official institute name and campus, because some IIT and NIT cards in our records omit the campus in the short name.

faqs.question: How many M.Tech colleges in India have fees under ₹1 lakh here?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published M.Tech / M.E. colleges with a recorded main-programme fee up to ₹{{budget}} lakh. Colleges without a usable fee on file are excluded.

faqs.question: What is a typical M.Tech fee on this list?
faqs.answer: The median recorded total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. For IIT and NIT cards, confirm the official circular before you treat the stored figure as a full cost.

faqs.question: Why does IIT Kharagpur show an M.Tech fee of ₹10,000?
faqs.answer: Our card lists M.Tech Aerospace Engineering at ₹10,000, the lowest figure we treat as quotable. That is unlikely to be the complete official programme fee, so use IIT Kharagpur's current fee notice.

faqs.question: Do these colleges admit only through GATE?
faqs.answer: Many public M.Tech seats use GATE, but this list also includes private and state-college programmes that may use another test or a sponsored route. Check the official admission page.

faqs.question: Is this a ranking of the best M.Tech / M.E. colleges under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: No. It is a fee filter. Branch, GATE cut-off and the official fee circular should guide the shortlist.
